page.layout: One printed page: one main text column with Latin and Arabic mixed, and a narrow marginal column on the right holding one Arabic and Latin note. Page number and running head at the top.

main_text.p: nius, اربع قواعد[?] quatuor fundamenta, quæ vocat الاصول الكبار i. e. radices magnas: quorum pri-mum الصفات والتوحيد فيها[?] i. e. Attributa [ Dei ] & unitas in iis, seu quæ cum iis confistit. sub hoc comprehendi quæstiones de الصفات الازلية اثباتا[?] عن جماعة ونفيا عن جماعة[?] i.e: attributis æternis, quæ ab aliis affirmantur, ab aliis negantur, nec non بيان[?] explicationem attributorum essentiæ, seu essentialium, & صفات الفعل[?] attributorum actionisالصفات الفعلية EhnolKassai., seu ab operibus desumptorum, & ما يجب لله[?] quid debeat Deus facere, & ما يجوز عليه وما يستحيل[?] quid possit de eo affirmari, & quid impossibile sit ei, de his controverti inter AlAssharios, & AlCeramios, & AlMojássemios, seu corporeitatis assertores, & Al-Motazalos. Secundum est فيه القدر والعدل[?] De-cretum divinum, & quæ in eo est æquitas: quod com-prehendit quæstiones de القضاء والقدر[?] propofito Dei, & decreto ejus, & الجبر[?] coactione [ hominis ad agendum ] & الكسب[?] concursu, seu cooperatione hominis in actionibus suis producendis, quæ sibi bonum vel malum acquirat: & ارادة الخير والشر[?] Voluntate [quâ vult Deus] bonum & malum, & المقدور[?] والمعلوم[?] eo quod sub potentia, & quod sub scientia cadit, afferentibus hæc aliis, aliis negantibus. De his in-ter AlKadarios, AlNajarios, AlJahbarios, AlAssharios, &

page.notes: Arabic words are only partly legible at this scan resolution and are marked [?]. The first line begins mid-word ("nius") and the page ends mid-sentence with "&", so the paragraph continues on the next page. The Arabic and transliterated names (AlAssharios, Kadarios, etc.) should be checked against the original. The note "EhnolKassai." is a printed name in the margin.
